position.guild_commitment: Approve Lantern Council attached to NG
position.janissariat_commitment: Not an owner; recognise exact Vigil Home proposal

messages.text: I still support NG and will sign Lantern Council attached to it. That repair contribution stands independently. I reject T2's Military article. Vigil Home guarantees the loss of civilian protection, while Restraint remains only a promise and Spear remains free to Raid. This is not a security concession I can verify through the commitment. Last month's success depended on the crown's relief and protection as well as military competence.

reason: Autonomy removes our scrutiny and makes Guard a breach of its ordinary duty. Communities two on the optimistic stated plan leaves little room for changed orders or undisclosed effects. I prefer retaining Interim to accepting those permanent terms. My military refusal does not revoke the separate Guild repair offer.
